decisions.story_title: FBI disrupts quartermaster infrastructure supporting Chinese cyber espionage
decisions.reason: FBI takedown of a multi-component proxy/recon framework (QScan, Fast Labyrinth, QTRouter, QTProxy) used by Chinese APTs against US defense, government, and critical infrastructure. Tracked by Lumen Black Lotus Labs.

decisions.story_title: OpenAI disrupts Russia-linked covert influence operation using ChatGPT
decisions.reason: OpenAI banned a cluster of accounts linked to a Russian influence operation that used ChatGPT to promote a fake Israeli think tank and spread pro-Russia narratives across social platforms.

decisions.story_title: Ubiquiti patches three max-severity flaws in UniFi Protect, Talk, and OS
decisions.reason: Three critical unauthenticated RCE/bypass vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-77537 (UniFi Protect input validation), CVE-2026-77550 (CRLF injection auth bypass on UniFi OS), CVE-2026-77554 (command injection in UniFi Talk). Low-complexity, no user interaction required.
